study type: Mixed-methods study incorporating participatory action research and quasi-experimental methods
outcome: Children's knowledge of how germs cause illness
Children's knowledge of how to remove germs from hands
cohort: The study included 651 children and teacher-trainers from 13 case study sites in Ahmedabad, India.
finding: Children demonstrated an improved understanding of the causes of bacterial disease and the health implications of not using adequate health-hygiene practices after participating in the workshops.
